classes.label: panoramic: down over the valley and mountains all round

method: 36 azimuths x 66 distances to 14.7 km on the Copernicus 30 m DSM, eye 2 m; depth/relief = mean of the best 9 azimuths; openness = share of azimuths whose horizon is >= 1.5 km away; enclosure = share with the horizon above 12 deg within 350 m
score_formula: 100 x clip(0.40 x min(depth/150,1)^0.7 + 0.35 x min(relief/400,1)^0.7 + 0.25 x openness - 0.5 x enclosure, 0, 1)
